% MacTeX units.sty math-mode behavior: optional values use tight spacing,
% units are upright, and unitfrac delegates to nicefrac with upright parts.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{units}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \node[draw,rounded corners,inner sep=5pt,align=left] {
    $d=\unit[12]{m}$\\
    $v=\unitfrac[36]{km}{h}$\\
    $a=\unitfrac{m}{s^2}$
  };
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
